verdict.rationale: Moneybird's own llms.txt links a first-party Webhooks getting-started guide in its developer docs that lets you 'get notified when something changes', so the product itself offers webhooks. The pack contains only this single one-line mention, so the depth of the capability is unproven. missing for 10: documented webhook registration endpoint or flow, list of subscribable event types, payload and signature details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
